ErrorClass.description: A closed error class, the port of Camel's Java exception hierarchy (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.7).

ExpectedFacade.description:
What the facade must answer one entry with: a recorded response, or a
problem named by class and code (G-FIXTURES). A problem expectation
carries no body: the profile's problem envelope owns that shape, and
the declared problem owns the status.

oneOf.description: The facade answers with this recorded response.

body.description: The response body the facade answers with.

headers.description: The response headers the facade answers with.

status.description: The status the facade answers with.

oneOf.description: The facade answers with the named problem.

class.description:
The error class the facade answers with; a declared class or a
class a declared root covers resolves it.

code.description: The declared problem code the facade fills its envelope with.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

FixtureEntry.description:
One fixture entry: the facade request, the upstream exchanges it
drives in the order the route makes them, and what the facade must
answer (G-FIXTURES, CONCEPT 13.3). At least one exchange is an
authoring invariant the checks refuse a suite without.

facadeRequest.description: The facade request this entry replays.

upstream.description: The upstream exchanges, in the order the route makes them.

FixtureProvenance.description:
Where a fixture's recording came from
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 13.3): captured from a live
system, or documented as an authored reconstruction.

oneOf.description: Recorded from the named live system.

reference.description: Where the recording came from, for review.

oneOf.description: Authored from the source system's documented behavior.

reference.description: The documentation the reconstruction follows, for review.

HttpMethod.description:
An HTTP method a facade operation or an upstream send may declare. The
method decides send safety: `GET` is safe, the write methods are not
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 8.7 and 9).

Intercept.description:
One declared intercept. Fixture replay intercepts `http` and `graphql`
sends and the token endpoint of an OAuth2 kind; nothing else is
interceptable.

oneOf.description: Intercept every send to the named endpoint.

endpoint.description: The pack endpoint id whose sends replay from the fixtures.

oneOf.description:
Intercept the token requests of the named endpoint's OAuth2 kind
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.2). Replay runs without
a credential: the recorded token request carries no credential
header or body, and the recorded reply's token is a synthetic
value a captured recording must replace before it is committed.

endpoint.description:
The pack endpoint whose token requests replay from the
fixtures.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

RecordedExchange.description:
One recorded upstream exchange: the send the route made and the reply
the source gave it.

response.description: The reply the source gave it.

RecordedFacadeRequest.description:
The facade request one entry replays: the operation it exercises, plus
the request the deployment receives. The operation is the facade-side
primary key of the entry; the profile owns its method.

body.description: The request body: absent, JSON `null`, or a value (G-FIXTURES).

operation.description: The profile operation this entry exercises.

path.description: The request path, with any template segments already filled.

RecordedRequest.description: One recorded upstream request the fixture replay matches against.

body.description: The request body: absent, JSON `null`, or a value (G-FIXTURES).

endpoint.description: The endpoint the request goes to.

path.description: The request path, with any template segments already filled.

tokenRequest.description:
Whether this request is the endpoint's token request (CONCEPT
10.2); only a token intercept answers it.

body.description: The reply body: absent, JSON `null`, or a value (G-FIXTURES).

status.description: The status the upstream answered with.

description: The fixture suite artifact (`AdapterFixture`), authored per pack.

intercepts.description:
The sends this suite intercepts, by endpoint id and token endpoint.
A route never declares its own test intercepts.

upstreamVersion.description: The upstream version the recording reflects.
